subject: DI03009011

body.en:
Definition

A distribution estimate quantifies and prices the designed route,support/cable system,accessories,protection,civil works and installation/testing required for a stated supply duty.

Explanation and application

  • Overhead(O H)uses supported conductors,insulators and mechanical hardware;underground(U G)uses rated cable,route protection,joints/terminations and excavation/reinstatement.
  • Compare capital,repair access,weather/excavation exposure,thermal conditions,ROWand reliability rather than material price alone.
  • Survey crossings,existing services,terrain,load growth and ownership boundaries before quantities;actual safety clearances and working methods require authorised design.
Four-core100mcable quantity?

100cable-metres,not400;tails/allowances are separately declared.

  • Overheadમાં supports,conductors,insulators/hardware;undergroundમાં rated cable,protection,joints,excavation/reinstatement હોય.
  • Capital,repair access,weather-excavation,thermal,ROW/reliability compare કરો;ફક્ત material price નહીં.
  • Crossings,services,terrain,growth/ownership survey કરો.Safety clearances/work methods authorised designથી લો.

Definition

An overhead line is an electrical circuit carried above ground by mechanically designed supports and insulating assemblies;its estimate includes electrical and structural items.

Explanation and application

  • Conductors require material,area,strand/type,quantity and ampacity/strength data;phase/neutral configuration and conductor spacing come from the approved design.
  • Poles,towers,crossarms,brackets and clamps maintain geometry and transfer weight/tension/wind loads;foundations and erection plant are not free accessories.
  • Insulators,dead-end fittings,jumpers,connectors,labels and protective devices need counted quantities matched to tangent/angle/dead-end/crossing structures,not one guessed set for all poles.

Definition

A stay(guy)is a tension member that transfers unbalanced support force to a designed anchor.Guarding is a designed protective arrangement at specified crossings/locations,not a normal load conductor.

Explanation and application

  • Stays include wire/rod,anchor hardware and specified stay insulation;their location and load capacity follow mechanical/soil design rather than an arbitrary number per pole.
  • Line/support earthing and bonding use approved electrodes/conductors/connections and testing;an earth wire does not replace required insulation or clearances.
  • A surge arrester limits specified transient overvoltage by a coordinated discharge path;it is not an ordinary breaker or a guarantee against all continuous overvoltage.Guarding/arrester/earthing items must match the design.

Definition

A span is the distance between adjacent supports;electrical clearance is the required separation between live conductors and ground,structures or other circuits under the specified conditions.

Explanation and application

  • Conductor ground clearance is checked at relevant maximum sag;horizontal spacing and structure clearance also consider wind swing and design conditions.
  • Include survey,foundation excavation/concrete,erection,lifting,stays,stringing/tensioning,guarding and testing as specified work items;field execution is utility-authorised work,not a student live-line procedure.
  • Use current applicable CEA/state/utility/crossing rules for numerical clearances and spans;the example lengths below are quantity assumptions,not legal design minima/maxima.

Definition

Safe distribution work is authorised work performed under the applicable design,competence,isolation,clearance,earthing and verification requirements for that network.

Explanation and application

  • Obtain utility/crossing permissions and locate all existing underground/overhead services;control public access,traffic,excavation collapse and mechanical lifting hazards.
  • No live pole work,cable cutting,unapproved pulling/jointing or removal of the sole protective earth;account for backfeed,induction and stored cable charge.
  • Use approved sag/clearance,mechanical design,earthing,guarding and test criteria;the syllabus lab equipment ratings do not authorise an11kV/33kVstudent installation.
